claim: Nimbus Mobile can export notes as PDF files.

passages.text: Sign in with your Nimbus account and your notes sync across all your devices.
Choose File › Export to save any note as a PDF or a Markdown file.
The free plan includes 500 notes; Plus removes the limit.

claim: Orca CLI supports single sign-on through Okta.

passages.text: Install it with npm, Homebrew, or a standalone binary from the releases page.
Sign in with SAML single sign-on through Okta, Azure AD or Google Workspace.
Administrators can require single sign-on for every member of the organization.

claim: Ledgerline Starter includes an audit log of account changes.

passages.text: Up to three users and one connected bank account.
Every change to an account is recorded in an exportable audit log, kept for seven years.
Pick the plan that fits the size of your finance team.

claim: The Fernway Python SDK automatically retries rate-limited requests.

passages.text: Install with pip install fernway and set your key in FERNWAY_API_KEY.
Throttled requests are queued and retried automatically once the Retry-After delay has passed.
Plug the unit into your modem and follow the steps in the app.
Wi-Fi 6E tri-band radio. Wi-Fi 7 is not supported on this model.
Updates install automatically overnight.

claim: Halcyon Reader keeps working without an internet connection.

passages.text: Your library is stored in your Halcyon account and appears on every device you sign in to.
Every feature keeps working with no connection; changes sync as soon as you are back online.

claim: Kitebridge Agent runs on Windows Server 2022.

passages.text: Supported on Windows Server 2019 and 2022, Ubuntu 22.04 and RHEL 9.
Works in current versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge.

claim: The Marlow Team plan includes 50 GB of storage per user.

passages.text: Each seat comes with 1 TB of storage and unlimited version history.
Each seat comes with 50 GB of storage and 90 days of version history.
You can switch plans at any time; changes are prorated.

claim: The Quarry Go SDK supports streaming responses.

passages.text: Set stream to true to receive the response as server-sent events.
Streaming responses are not available yet; every call returns once the full response is ready.

claim: Vantor Desktop can be installed on Linux.

passages.text: Get it from the App Store or Google Play.
Available for Windows 10 and later and macOS 13 and later. There is no Linux build.
Version 4.2 adds a dark theme and faster search.
